message.content: {"note_claim": "VAR can review yellow cards issued due to mistaken identity, as happened during USA vs Paraguay when Tim Ream's booking was overturned and given to Miguel Almirón for simulation.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The revision to the laws of the game, made earlier this year, gives referees latitude to use video assisted review to overturn red and yellow cards issued to the incorrect players.", "reason": "The article directly confirms that VAR can review yellow cards for mistaken identity and describes the Ream/Almirón incident exactly as the note states."}

parsed.note_claim: VAR can review yellow cards issued due to mistaken identity, as happened during USA vs Paraguay when Tim Ream's booking was overturned and given to Miguel Almirón for simulation.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The revision to the laws of the game, made earlier this year, gives referees latitude to use video assisted review to overturn red and yellow cards issued to the incorrect players.
parsed.reason: The article directly confirms that VAR can review yellow cards for mistaken identity and describes the Ream/Almirón incident exactly as the note states.
